view.en: First-person 3D shooter: the crosshair is at the centre and your weapon at the lower right. The boss's name, phase and health bar are at the top; ammo, health, armour and the current weapon at the bottom. The arena has pillars, crates and other cover, with ammo, medical and armour pickups on the floor

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose if your health reaches zero; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate: each medical or armour pickup can be taken only once, while ammo respawns over time

mouse.en: Y > 0 looks down; pitch is limited to about ±89°

notes.en: Each fight starts with a fixed set of weapons (such as shotguns, machine guns, a rocket launcher or a coilgun, depending on the fight); switch weapons when ammo runs low
Most boss attacks travel in straight lines: strafing and ducking behind cover work best
Bosses flinch briefly when hit; heavy weapons such as rockets interrupt them more easily
Coilgun-type attacks first lock onto where you are; a red warning appears at the centre of the screen, and strafing right after the lock dodges the shot

options.fire_late: fire, starting late in the 200 ms

summary.en: A heavy tracked machine armed with a chain gun and rocket launchers rolls at you across an open-air arena.

tell.en: It turns toward you; it always uses this at close range

effect.en: A stream of instant-hit bullets that continues as long as it can see you

counter.en: Break line of sight behind cover

tell.en: At longer range it turns toward you and fires three rockets about 0.3 s apart

effect.en: The rockets fly straight at where you were when fired and splash on impact

counter.en: Strafe so they miss, and stay off walls

summary.en: A heavy gunship hovering above you attacks with twin machine guns and rocket salvos; cover only blocks low shots.

tell.en: About 0.9 s of wind-up as it turns; it always uses this at close range

effect.en: Both guns fire continuously, and it keeps firing more often while you are in front of it

counter.en: Get to its side or put a full-height pillar between you

tell.en: After about 1.2 s of wind-up it launches four rockets at once

effect.en: Each rocket aims at you and hits hard

counter.en: Start strafing as soon as you see the wind-up

phases.en: It always flies a little above you, so low cover does not block its fire

summary.en: A two-phase fight: first a twin chain-gun mech, then the pilot that jumps out of it when it is destroyed; the two share one health bar.

tell.en: After about 0.8 s of wind-up both chain guns fire together

effect.en: Instant-hit bullets that continue while it can see you

counter.en: Break line of sight with a pillar

tell.en: After a short wind-up it launches a slow, large green orb

effect.en: In flight the orb zaps visible targets nearby, and its hit or blast is extremely damaging

counter.en: Get far from it and behind cover

tell.en: The pilot in the second phase also launches the large green orb
After a short wind-up it fires a stream of blue energy bolts sweeping from one side to the other

effect.en: The bolts are fast and hit everything along the sweep

counter.en: Strafe or back behind cover before the sweep reaches you

tell.en: While charging, a coilgun-charging warning appears, then it locks onto your position at that moment (red aim line / warning)

effect.en: An instant piercing shot along the locked line, very damaging

counter.en: Strafe the moment the lock warning appears

phases.en: Phase one is the twin-cannon mech; once it is destroyed the pilot appears and phase two begins

summary.en: A humanoid heavy machine in a factory arena that attacks with energy-gun triple shots, rockets and a sweeping chain gun.

tell.en: It turns toward you, steps back slightly and fires three energy bolts

effect.en: The bolts fly straight at you

tell.en: At longer range it winds up for about 2 seconds, then fires three rockets

effect.en: The rockets hit and splash hard

counter.en: The long wind-up is a good window to attack; dodge once it fires

tell.en: After briefly turning it fires for about 2 seconds without turning further

counter.en: It does not track you while firing, so run sideways out of its line

summary.en: A heavy soldier with a giant blade on one arm and a coilgun on the other, fighting at both ranges in an arena ringed by pillars.

tell.en: Up close it raises its blade, with a swing sound and motion

effect.en: Two heavy slashes that knock you back

counter.en: Do not stand next to it; keep a medium distance

tell.en: When you are a little away, it first locks onto your position (the HUD shows the lock and an aim line), then fires about 0.4 s later

effect.en: An instant piercing shot along the locked line, very damaging

counter.en: Strafe as soon as you see the lock; it does not use this when you are very close

summary.en: An agile clawed beast that leaps across a lab arena to close in, then strikes with both claws.

tell.en: Up close it swings its left and right claws in turn

effect.en: Each claw hurts and pushes you back slightly; it keeps clawing while you stay in reach

counter.en: Back away and shoot while retreating

tell.en: When it is some distance away at a similar height, it leaps at you

effect.en: The pounce hurts on hit; it cannot be interrupted until it lands

counter.en: Move sideways right after it takes off, then hit it as it lands
